== Notes ==
* The [[AI]] will use this skill to start an attack chain, without regard to its interruption effect.
* This skill will not disable spells that are prevented from being interrupted.

== Trivia ==
* The face on the skill icon appears to be [[w:Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]] (portrayed by Mark Hamill) as seen in a certain scene concerning the fate of his father in [[w:The Empire Strikes Back|Star Wars Episode V]].
